blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) on Thursday cautioned protesters not to test the law enforcement agency’s resolve ahead of rallies expected this Monday, September 21 to protest corruption and mark the 54th anniversary of the declaration of martial law. PNP public information chief Col. Allen Rae Co issued the warning in a press briefing in Camp Crame when asked if the police will arrest rallyists with balaclavas or face coverings, similar to those seen during the riots during the September 21 protests in Manila last year. “Mayroon naman kasing ibang possible uses ang balaclava, but not during this […]...
